description: This file contains file I/O utility functions for reading and writing hostname data from XML and text files, used within the touchstone component of a larger project.

methods.name: extractHostnameFromCommConf
methods.description: Parses an XML configuration file to extract the hostname/IP from the <hostnameIP> node.

methods.name: extractHostnameFromMarker
methods.description: Reads a hostname from a text file, typically /tmp/server.txt.

methods.name: saveHostnameToMarker
methods.description: Writes a hostname string to a specified text file, typically /tmp/server.txt.
